title: The Line Nobody Could See: Contrast, Text on a Colour and a Palette That Survives a White Background

questions.question: What is the contrast ratio of black on white?
Why is white text on pure green unreadable?
options: Green is nearly as light as white
questions.explanation: The ratio is 1.37, where black text is 15.3. The average of the channels is 85, which says dark, and is wrong.

questions.question: Which text colour does text_on choose?
options: The one with the higher brightness average
The one with the higher contrast against the background
questions.explanation: The better of black and white was always at least 4.67.

questions.question: How many of the eight palette colours reach a contrast of 3 on white?
Why is the channel made linear before the weights are applied?
options: The value stored in a pixel is not proportional to the light
questions.explanation: Mid grey 128 is about a fifth of the luminance. The luminance of 128 is 0.2159, not 0.5.

questions.question: Two colours have a high contrast against the page. Are they easy to tell apart?
questions.explanation: Contrast against the background says nothing about the difference between them. The lesson says so under what it does not do.
